 Via Purdue Boilermakers - Official Athletics Website, 21h ago SAVANNAH, Ga. – Among a pool of 3,000 applicants, Purdue Baseball alumnus Troy Viola emerged as a player Banana Ball wanted as part of a league that has soared to stadium-filling popularity – culminating in Viola being a first-round pick by the defending league champion the final week of October. The Texas Tailgaters selected Viola with their No. 1 pick at the Oct. 28 Banana Ball Draft, which was held at Grayson Stadium in Savannah and streamed live on the Banana Ball YouTube channel that boasts 413,000 subscribers.
